bond_changes.derivation: Net hydrogen (or deuterium for compound 35) gain is implicit in conversion of the propargylic alcohol to the allene.
The source structures show promotion of the propargylic C-C single bond to an allene double bond.

coverage.derivation: The broken C-O bond and C-C triple-bond order decrease are retained as limitations, not new-bond labels.
